name: Saved view
description: A saved filter over one of the CRM's lists (forge 40d): its owner's own, or shared with everyone using the CRM.

fields.name: Entity
fields.description: The entity type it lists, such as crmContact

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The view's name, such as My open deals

fields.name: Where
fields.description: Field id → value the records must have

fields.name: Filter
fields.description: A records filter: {field, op, value}, or {and|or: [filters]}

fields.name: Owner
fields.description: The person responsible for it; empty for a shared record any sales rep may change or claim. Changed by managers with record.reassign

fields.name: Shared
fields.description: Shown to everyone using the CRM, not only its owner
